headline: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint plans retail stablecoin as HSBC RedCoin launches
summary: Anchorpoint, a stablecoin-issuing joint venture led by Standard Chartered, plans to launch a retail product on a public blockchain following the launch of HSBC RedCoin.
why: Stablecoins are digital tokens pegged to traditional currencies, increasingly integrated into traditional banking and payment infrastructure by major financial institutions.

impacts.name: Crypto and Digital Assets
impacts.why: The entry of major traditional banks into retail stablecoins may increase adoption and regulatory scrutiny.
